name: Implement Valkey rebuild-on-cold-start protocol
description: Scan PGlite for open missions, unclosed leases, pending gates, scheduled obligations, unacknowledged work. Repopulate Valkey Streams, Sorted Sets, TTL keys. Must complete in < 1 second for typical state. Must be idempotent. Handle all wipe scenarios. Display recovery banner during rebuild. This task is scoped to the current scaffold — the real PGlite-derived rebuild is owned by the cold-start rebuild task (0025).
